fact: UNCDF says the Bank of Sierra Leone decided in February 2020 on standalone financial consumer protection guidelines for all regulated institutions, drafted and reviewed with UNCDF from April to June 2020, with public consultation still to come.

UNCDF says Bank of Sierra Leone mobile money service providers are subject to certain disclosure and transparency requirements, and consumer protection elements are in its mobile money and agent guidelines.

The Bank of Sierra Leone strategy says BSL has a process for tracking complaints and redressals, with its Consumer Protection Section holding commercial bank complaint data and mobile money providers reporting complaints to BSL.
The Bank of Sierra Leone strategy reports complaints tracked from mobile money providers in a period ending 2021: 12,993 cash reversals, 5,748 fraud, 1,793 PIN resets and 498 account unlocks.
